nodes.name: Start - Purpose
nodes.notes:
📋 Workflow: Job Finder - Remote Cloud Discovery

🎯 Purpose: Discover new remote cloud/DevOps entry-level roles from public job APIs, filter for keywords, deduplicate, and send WhatsApp notifications to the user.

⏰ Schedule: Every 6 hours (constrained by Remotive's rate guidance: ~4 requests/day)

📡 Sources: Remotive, RemoteOK, Arbeitnow APIs (free, no auth required)

💾 Dedup Storage: n8n Data Table 'remote_job_finder_seen_jobs' (columns: jobId, source, title, company, url, firstSeenAt)

📲 Notify: WhatsApp via Twilio Sandbox (credentials: Twilio API)

🔧 Env Vars: N8N_USER_WHATSAPP_NUMBER (user's WhatsApp in E.164 format)

⚠️ First-run note: Seed the Data Table before activating to avoid notification flood (see README.md step 7)
